why: The r/utaustin items mix destroying rival marks with converting them into the room's own sign.

why.T3-073: The concepts recount and measure what happened to the finished TagPro/Fagpro work, including its struggle, design choice and evolution, rather than only saving it as a static record.

why.T3-044: The concepts track outsiders brought to TagPro by the r/place mark: a new player, traffic, subscribers, trending and registration stats.

why.T3-063: The concepts are moderator or bot removals of links during the push under posting rules, including No Participation and self-post requirements.

why.T3-006: The item has multiple calls to erase, make war on, and kill rival marks such as A&M and GiantBomb, which is the attack/defacement gate rather than only conversion or space-taking.
why.T3-068: It also repeatedly turns a rival logo or scoreboard into the room's own colors or result, as with leaving the T white and replacing purple with orange and rewriting the KU-TX score.
why.T3-061: It also proposes replacing A&M's spot and preparing to fight Huskers for border space, which is taking a neighbour's ground.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-006 carries erasing and attacking, but not the concepts that turn a rival mark into the room's own sign or rewrite its score.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Concepts such as leaving the T white and replacing purple with orange, rewriting the KU-TX score, and redirecting the script at that score satisfy T3-068's gate for converting a neighbour's art.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-068 if forced to one; lose the conversion/rewriting dimension and keep only destruction/attack.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-006's erasing and T3-068's converting do not cover the item's proposals to replace A&M's spot and fight Huskers for border space.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1242684 proposes replacing A&M's spot, C1279898 prepares to fight Huskers for that space, and C1145368 calls to take over Tennessee's logo, satisfying T3-061's gate for pushing into a neighbour's space.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-061 if forced to one; lose the territorial expansion dimension while keeping attack and conversion.

why.T3-043: The concepts mainly thank, hail, shout out and credit the people who made or protected the sign, rather than simply celebrating the finished work.

why.T3-121: The concepts concern bans, unbans and reports used to sanction or exclude members over report abuse during the push, including reversals and restorations.

why.T3-001: The concepts reveal the community's own fake league-site failure and fake goodbye as April Fools jokes, with the 3D script joke clarifying the staged falsehood.

why.T3-028: The concepts center on scripts or bots made, shared and run to build and defend the logo.
why.T3-070: It also posts overlays, coordinates and templates for placers to follow by hand.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-028 covers the scripts and automated defense, but not the posted overlays and template guidance the room uses to place by hand.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: The item has distinct overlay/template concepts, such as a shitty overlay for the boxes, a posted overlay and position, and an overlay for r/place, satisfying T3-070.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-070 if forced to one; lose the hand-following template/overlay side and keep the scripted automation side.

why.T3-076: The concepts repeatedly tell Longhorn attackers to stop destroying neighbours, urge cease-fire, and reject sacrificing GiantBomb.
why.T3-024: It also includes restraint toward others' work: moving to avoid India, leaving the UT logo alone, being willing to move, and letting GiantBomb stay.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-076 covers stopping the room's attackers, but not the concepts where members choose to spare or move around others' work without an attack to rein in.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Concepts such as moving to avoid the Indian flag, apologizing and leaving the UT logo alone, and being willing to move satisfy T3-024's gate for keeping the room's work off others' art.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-024 if forced to one; lose the explicit non-covering/restraint side while keeping the call to stop attacks.

why.T3-037: The concepts dismiss or demand an end to the canvas event and being done looking at pixels, judging the venture itself rather than complaining about sub posts.

why.T3-020: The concepts repeatedly locate or relocate the Longhorn mark: ideal coordinates, moving from dolphins, room near Skyrim, alternate coordinates, second area.
